name: Jiangsu gdk Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu gdk Biotechnology Co., Ltd. operates as a biotechnology firm specializing in the comprehensive research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of human vaccines, alongside providing related services. Its current portfolio includes a quadrivalent split-virus influenza vaccine and a lyophilized human rabies vaccine. The company's pipeline is strategically focused on preventing major infectious diseases such as influenza, rabies, chickenpox, shingles, and pneumonia. This enterprise was established in 2008 and is headquartered in Taizhou, China.
